programs.description: A group of adventurers go to an island that is rumoured to have treasure in order to look for it. In their quest they encounter many adversities but try to fulfil their mission.
The eldest daughter-in-law of a family faces various hardships at the hands of her mother-in-law. The youngest daughter-in-law teaches her a lesson and makes her realise her mistakes.
Jayaraman, a petty thief, changes his ways when he meets a rich lady who is mentally ill and decides to work as her bodyguard.
CBI officer Alexander investigates a complex case involving murder, smuggling and political corruption. However, his search leads him to a dangerous game of cat and mouse with powerful adversaries.
A businessman dearly loves his daughter and wants to ensure that she is always protected. Meanwhile, his close friend and business partner hatches a plot to usurp his wealth.
Sethupathi, a young man, falls in love with Lingappan Naicker, the village head's daughter Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the girl's father asks Senathipathi, Sethu's older brother, to protect her.
Jeevan's father helps Annachi after she is cheated by his brother. He soon becomes the object of affection of Annachi's daughter, but he turns her down to pursue other goals in life.
